aggressive.label: AGGRESSIVE (capped — stale listings need price drops not more spend)

_promo_burst.note: REVERTED 2026-07-07 (store analysis: ROAS -37% on burst, paying premium to promote self-selling $2-10 cards). Emptied price_band_tiers (back to age-based 8%-max ladder), cap 200/daily 10. Burst was 2026-06-19 committee, top band 15% JC override.

_rate_cut_2026_08_06.note: Cut across the board: low 3->2%, standard/aggressive/max 8->4%, burst remnants sub3 7->0%, b3to5 10->2%, b5to10 11->3%, b10plus 15->5%, cap 200->40. Also fixed bulk_set_bids: eBay's create-ads endpoint can't update an existing ad's bid (errorId 35036), so 222 listings from the 6/19 burst stayed enrolled at the old 7-15% bids for weeks after the config 'revert'. bulk_set_bids now diffs against the live campaign and deletes+recreates ads whose bid changed.

_panel_2026_08_15.note: 6-agent promotions panel: reactivated June price-band policy (<$2 0% / $2-10 3% / $10+ 8%) which had sat as an empty price_band_tiers since the July burst revert. Cap 40->75 (cost-per-sale: worst-case realized spend at these rates is ~$60-75/mo even with 100% attribution). Demotion loop rewritten to exempt <14d listings and cut cheapest/oldest first (old loop cut highest price first). Rates on >120d items halved in code. Distinct from the July burst: that bled ROAS at 7-15% flat rates; top band here is 8% on $10+ only.
